**Weaknesses & Critical Gaps:**
While the idea is novel, the empirical validation contains a critical weakness that impacts the credibility of the results.

This is not a minor oversight; it is the cornerstone of the system. If the detector has false positives, the archive is filled with "solved" tasks the agent never actually solved, invalidating the archive quality and the adaptive behavior claims. Without this validation, the "adaptive" behavior shown in Figure 2 could be a hallucination of the system's state rather than actual agent progress.
